title: Red Hat Security Advisory: OpenShift Container Platform 4.16.75 packages and security update
description: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 4.16.75 includes a security update addressing a vulnerability in the openshift-ansible installer container. The installer downloads and executes a remote inventory script without verifying its integrity, which could lead to security risks. Users of OpenShift Container Platform 4.16 are advised to upgrade to the updated packages and images provided in this release to mitigate the issue.
